title: Implement job list item cards
userStory: As a user, I want each job displayed as a card showing key info so that I can quickly scan the history.
acceptanceCriteria: Card shows: status icon, workspace name, Ask/Edit badge, question (2-line clamp)
Shows timestamp (relative, e.g., 5m ago) and duration
Click card to open detail modal
Delete button (trash icon) on each card
